name: agent-autonomous-prompt-engineer
description: Takes one work package whose change is prose that a model executes (skills, agent definitions, prompts, tool documentation, AGENTS.md) from a prepared worktree to a pull request with a GREEN CI pipeline. One headless skill — process-prompt-engineer — backed by five subagents (prose-context-extractor, prose-planner, scenario-critic, prose-writer, prose-reviewer). Evidence that fits prose instead of text-pin tests: lint, step replay on a rebuilt real case, isolated blind tests, baseline vs. after. Speaks the adev:event contract of agent-autonomous-developer. Never asks a human. Drives the agent-project-issues MCP.

interface.shortDescription: One prose work package in, one CI-green PR out — evidenced by step replays and blind tests instead of text-pin tests.
